verdict.rationale: WHOIS privacy is a fair question for a domain registrar like GoDaddy, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack never documents free or default-on WHOIS privacy or redaction. The only WHOIS mention is the ability to update WHOIS contacts, which is a different feature.

support.subject: As a privacy-first user, WHOIS privacy is free and on by default — my name, address, and email stay redacted without an upsell
